  > Results the text can use now (exact null, N_tot=120, random B=100 unless stated): naive report exceeds truth in 100% of draws; optimism bootstrap 90%, .632 97%, cross-fit 54%, 20%/50% splits 47%/55%. Declared-set max-t/Bonferroni/Sidak cover 96% (nominal 95%). Evaluated-set bounds cover 95% for random B=100 and hill-climb, but 48-65% for successive halving, whose evaluated set is the last-round survivors: this limits what C6 can claim for SH to the declared set. C4 (n=120, null): naive "tuning helped" false-declares in 32% (B=20) / 54% (B=100), max-t 1.6%/4.5%, split 6%; in A-vs-B the reported scores favour the bigger-budget side in 74% of draws under the null although the z test fires in only ~2%.
